Nine different grounded everyday poses: 1 standing relaxed facing front, 2 three-quarter view mid-step, 3 side view reaching one hand out, 4 sitting cross-legged, 5 kneeling on one knee, 6 standing holding a drinking glass, 7 looking back over one shoulder, 8 crouching with one palm flat on the ground, 9 standing with arms loosely at sides seen from behind at three-quarter so the face still shows. Same attentive, slightly uncertain expression on every face: one person without a central body. Complete heads, hands and feet inside the margins. No extra person, bust, portrait, reflection, silhouette, shadow figure, floor line, scenery, props other than the one glass, text other than the heading, subtitle and label.
